_comment: Customer #1 (the project owner) skill enable/disable state, per v5.0 Phase D + active-skills.schema.json. Skills are UNIVERSAL by design -- they carry no per-skill configurable block (the directive's 'most skills are universal' rule); the only per-customer knob is which skills are ON. Boolean-replace semantics (A2): a customer's active-skills.json wholesale replaces the factory enable map. Tier entitlement (A7) still gates which skills a tier may enable. the project owner (senior-dev) runs all 7 installed skills.
